create_mask_image_modeling: create a MaskImageModeling instance with pred_ratio, patch_size, and RandMasking strategy for iBOT-style masking
use_block_masking: use BlockMasking to generate spatial block masks with configurable aspect ratio for image patches
use_tube_masking: use TubeMasking to extend a frame-level mask across all temporal frames of a video clip
use_random_frame_masking: use RandomFrameMasking to mask out entire random frames from a video clip based on prediction ratio
use_ibot_style_mask_image: use ibot_style_mask_image to apply random or block masking to a tensor image with configurable patch size
